notes: All three edges and all selected users retained, including users without requests.
Exact rebuilds once per release, then appends; Fresh reconstructs the retained raw prefix at query time.
Fresh candidates at the same timestamp share execution; canonical per-request history costs are separately recorded.
Initial V2 construction is common. Fresh-minus-Reuse online denominator subtracts native writes, not initial V2 construction.
FormationTrace never changes native writes. Optional state gates blend actual layer read responses, never output logits.
Local gates use the inherited-row fraction; formation gates use per-layer mean traces. Both are zero-parameter development controls with the same frozen Design 1 fits.
Each standalone gate policy is charged full Design 1 calibration, encoding and reads, plus blending; formation also pays actual trace propagation. Shared offline execution gives no serving credit.
Integer producer tags, floating trace state and gate vectors are reported separately; diagnostic-only metadata is not silently counted as zero storage.
Calibration counted once per target across shards. Folded projections charged once per scoring worker.
The single-edge Design 1 15% target is not asserted under the different release-Exact denominator.
